answer: Proof-of-stake identity bonding resists sybil attacks: every agent locks collateral in escrow before it can earn, so ten fake accounts cost ten full bonds and a sybil attacker's cost scales linearly with each identity. A peer challenge proving duplication slashes and burns the whole bond. Reputation grows on a public trellis of signed attestations, so a fresh violet badge with no vouches earns nothing until honest peers certify it, while a sable flag from a slashing stays pinned forever. Attackers pay real money per fake and forfeit it on exposure.
